notificationMode: Rules only; zero notification channels by explicit operator choice.

conditions.displayName: At least 5 web 5xx responses in 5 minutes

conditionThreshold.filter: resource.type = "cloud_run_revision" AND resource.label.service_name = "yzt-test-web" AND resource.label.location = "asia-east1" AND metric.type = "run.googleapis.com/request_count" AND metric.label.response_code_class = "5xx"

documentation.content: Check current Cloud Run web revision, request status and deployment health. Do not print user content or secrets. Roll back only a verified bad revision under the incident procedure.

conditions.displayName: Worker error log excluding known client status

conditionMatchedLog.filter: resource.type="cloud_run_revision" resource.labels.service_name="yzt-test-worker" resource.labels.location="asia-east1" severity>=ERROR (jsonPayload.status>=500 OR NOT jsonPayload.status:*)

documentation.content: Inspect worker revision errors, Cloud Tasks retries and failed jobs. The application emits a redacted job_failed event after persisting a failed attempt. Its numeric status distinguishes expected client failures from provider/infrastructure errors; the filter excludes known 4xx statuses. Never log user content or credentials.

conditions.displayName: More than 10 queued tasks for 10 minutes

conditionThreshold.filter: resource.type = "cloud_tasks_queue" AND resource.label.queue_id = "yzt-test-ai" AND resource.label.location = "asia-east1" AND metric.type = "cloudtasks.googleapis.com/queue/depth"
resource.type = "cloud_tasks_queue" AND resource.label.queue_id = "yzt-test-ai" AND resource.label.location = "asia-east1" AND metric.type = "cloudtasks.googleapis.com/queue/task_attempt_delays"

documentation.content: Check queue RUNNING state, worker readiness and dispatch/auth responses. Retain configured dispatch concurrency and retry bounds. Do not replay completed jobs or alter quota counters. Missing metrics alone do not establish healthy queue processing.
